zh.title: FAA撥款1200萬美元資助19家公司無人機研究測試
zh.summary: FAA撥款1200萬美元；資助19家公司進行無人機研究測試
body: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）宣佈，已向19家公司撥款1200萬美元，用於無人機研究與測試計畫，以協助在國家空域系統中安全地擴大無人機運作。
這些款項係透過無人機系統（UAS）廣播計畫（Broad Agency Announcement，BAA）發放。該計畫資助與FAA指定之UAS測試場域合作的企業，以測試及評估支援安全無人機整合的技術。
FAA署長Bryan Bedford表示，這項計畫提供另一種方式，可直接與產業及測試場域夥伴合作，處理對安全無人機整合至關重要的技術，並將提供更好的資料，協助辨識並瞭解營運挑戰。
參與計畫的公司包括General Atomics、NAVMAR、SPS Aerial Remote Sensing、ANRA Technologies、Devorto Corporation、DroneUp LLC等。

en.title: FAA awards $12 million to 19 companies for drone research and testing
en.summary: FAA awards $12M to 19 firms; funds research to support safe drone integration
body: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) announced it has awarded $12 million to 19 companies for drone research and testing projects that will help safely expand drone operations in the National Airspace System.

The awards were made through the Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) Program, which funds companies working with FAA-designated UAS Test Sites to test and evaluate technologies that support safe drone integration.

FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford said the program gives the agency another way to work directly with industry and test site partners on critical technologies, and will provide better data to help identify and understand operational challenges.
Participating companies include General Atomics, NAVMAR, SPS Aerial Remote Sensing, ANRA Technologies, DroneUp LLC, OneRadio Corporation, and others, per the announcement.
